## Which anchor

## Your Credence

`[0.00 – 1.00]`, and ideally a range rather than a point.

**This matters more than a point estimate.** If you would put
`gwt_architecture_no_metacognition` at 0.05 rather than the lab's assumed
0.15–0.60 band, say so — the disagreement *is* the finding, and we would rather
record it than average it away.
